DJIA Market Happenings For Monday, January 14, 2019 Posted by admin on January 14th, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -180 points.
Friday the Dow was down -5.97 (-0.02%) at 23,995.95.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.87%.
There were 15 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Pfizer (PFE) +1.35%, UnitedHealth (UNH) +1.14% and Intel (INTC) +0.76%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Walgreens (WBA) -1.06%, Apple (AAPL) -0.98% and Chevron (CVX) -0.80%.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is unchanged at $2.245 per gallon.
